query:
SELECT 
  ph.cardId,
  c.name,
  COUNT(*) as transaction_count,
  ROUND(AVG(ph.price), 2) as avg_price,
  ROUND(MIN(ph.price), 2) as min_price,
  ROUND(MAX(ph.price), 2) as max_price
FROM priceHistory ph
JOIN cards c ON ph.cardId = c.id
WHERE c.snkrdunkId IN ('210022', '781745', '819562', '150847')
  AND ph.grade = 'PSA10'
  AND ph.soldAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY ph.cardId, c.name
ORDER BY c.snkrdunkId;
